notes: Account summary: Harborlight Edge Reserve is a mid-to-large fintech firm building latency-critical trading assistants and market signal reranking. MVP is a real-time trading assistant that needs sub-120ms p99 inference for short prompts and high sustained throughput during market opens. They are evaluating Redwood Dedicated + Private for VPC isolation and KMS. Specific reserved GPU pool planning asks: - Two-region reserved pools (primary us-east-1, secondary us-west-2) split 70/30 baseline with 40% warm-hot headroom for failover. - Target overall sustained throughput: 12k completion tokens/sec (peak 20k tokens/sec) across the prod fleet. - Latency SLOs: p50 < 35ms, p95 < 80ms, p99 < 120ms for standard chat flows (max 1k tokens). - GPU sizing: prefer H100 for peak low-latency inference; asked for hybrid plan with A100-backed batching nodes for bulk reranking/embeddings jobs. - Failover plan: cross-region warm standby (pre-warmed KV caches for top 1k prompts), automated routing with health-based failover. Cold-start window tolerance for non-critical batch jobs up to 300s. - Headroom policy: keep 30-40% reserved capacity to absorb spikes during market open; automatic short-term burst allowed with prefunded credits. - SLA asks: 99.95% uptime across dedicated pools, credit for p99 latency violations (sliding window), explicit throughput guarantees (tokens/sec) with rollback to cheaper model variants on capacity shortfall. - Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, per-model capacity alarms. Quote from CTO: "If your reserved pool can't hold latency through market open, we can't move to a hosted plan." PoC scope proposed: 2-week dedicated capacity PoC in us-east-1 + failover test to us-west-2, simulated market open with 2x baseline traffic, measure p99 and cold-start behaviour. Pricing ask: sample TCO for 6-12 months reserved GPU contract, including headroom and burst pricing. Next steps: - Run sizing workshop 2026-03-10 (infra + finance). - Legal to review draft SLA with credit formula. - Deliver PoC plan and preliminary pricing by 2026-03-17.
